items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I knowed him, but I never did get to hear him play too much.

ctx.x: so many here. We had, I think it was three or four here pretty good, and something went with them. I think they went home someplace. I missed them.
Did you know Lightning when he was here?
Lightning, Lightning left before. I knowed him, but I never did get to hear him play too much.
